note: Read 2026-10-30 on the Transport Department's site. A private car driving licence is had from 18, after the driving test; a newly qualified driver of a private car first holds a probationary driving licence (HK$90) and must complete a 12-month probationary driving period before applying for a full driving licence. So the full licence is kept from 19, 18 and the 12 months added (a reading; offences extend the period). The fee schedule (TD341, 2026) gives a full driving licence at HK$900 for an applicant aged 60 or below; a full licence is valid for 10 years at 60 or below. Exchange: the countries and places in Schedule 4 of the Road Traffic (Driving Licences) Regulations (Cap. 374B), whose licence holders can apply for direct issue of a full licence without a test (on the conditions of form TD63A, not held): Australia, Austria, Bangladesh, Belgium, Canada, mainland China, Taiwan, Macao, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Iceland, India, Ireland, Israel, Italy, Japan, Korea, Luxembourg, Malaysia, the Netherlands, New Zealand, Nigeria, Norway, Pakistan, Portugal, Singapore, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, South Africa, the United Kingdom with Alderney, Bermuda, Guernsey, the Isle of Man and Jersey, and the United States; the list's "S.W. Africa" (with South Africa) isn't held as Namibia, and Alderney is held within Guernsey. The Hong Kong identity card is the Immigration Department's, the ids engine's.
